definitions.gloss: military service; conscription; compulsory military duty
definitions.explanation: The obligation or act of serving in the military, especially through a draft or conscription system. Japan abolished conscription after World War II, so the word is mainly used historically or when discussing other countries.

examples.japanese: {兵役|へいえき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧。

examples.english: In that country, men are obligated to serve in the military.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦時中|せんじちゅう}→戦時中：28629_senjichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{兵役|へいえき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{召集|しょうしゅう}→召集：11951_shoushuu⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{三|さん}{年間|ねんかん}→三年間：28861_sannenkan⟧⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{服|ふく}した→服す：29104_fukusu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather was called up for military service during the war and served three years in the army.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{兵|へい}→兵：29510_hei⟧ (soldier) + {役|えき} (service, duty). Japan's constitution renounces war and maintains no draft system, so {兵役|へいえき} is primarily used in historical contexts (pre-1945 Japan) or when discussing countries that still have conscription, such as South Korea, Israel, or Singapore.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {兵役|へいえき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧: to enter military service
- {兵役|へいえき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧: military service obligation
- {兵役|へいえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{免|まぬが}れる→免れる：10548_manugareru⟧: to be exempt from military service
- {兵役|へいえき}⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧: conscientious objection; refusal of military service
- {兵役|へいえき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{召集|しょうしゅう}→召集：11951_shoushuu⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be called up for service

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {徴兵|ちょうへい}: conscription, the draft (the system of mandatory enrollment)
- ⟦{従軍|じゅうぐん}→従軍：22877_juugun⟧: serving in a military campaign (emphasizes active duty in a specific conflict)
- ⟦{入隊|にゅうたい}→入隊：12064_nyuutai⟧: enlistment, joining a military unit
